messages.author: bbcf4d8ac9464c54
messages.subject: diploid RIL populations
parts:
We are planning to use R/QTL for analysis of an diploid RIL population
(RI6) which still contains a fair amount of residual heterozygosity.
Is R/QTL able to deal with residual heterozygosity? My initial
impression is, is that these scores are being ignored.

Thanks,
Richard

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] diploid RIL populations
parts:
R/qtl can't currently deal with residual heterozygosity in RIL.

Karl
